# DSH PR Review Action

> A CI-native port of the Claude Code Action idea, built for DeepSeek Harness. It reviews a pull
> r
equest with a cost-capped headless DSH run, writes a Markdown review, and optionally posts it.
This is a **review**, not an approval, merge, or security audit.
## Workflow
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Set `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` as a repository secret. The action sets up Node 22 and installs `@deepseek-ai

/dsh`, installs this
bundle into the `headless` profile, reads `gh pr diff`, and asks the `pr-review
` skill for a review.
## Inputs
| Input | Default | Meaning |

| `github-token` | required | Needs `pull-requests: write` to comment |
| `api-key` | required | Dee

pSeek API key for DSH |
| `comment` | `true` | Post the review as a PR comment |
| `max-minutes` | `

15` | Hard wall-clock cap |
| `dsh-version` | `latest` | Pin `@deepseek-ai/dsh` for reproducibility

5` | Hard wall-clock cap |

## Cost and security limits

- The wall-clock cap is **not** a token cap. DSH headless has no per-run token flag here; keep
`max-

minutes` small and use a dedicated API key/budget.
- Use `on: pull_request`, **not** `pull_request_t

arget`. A fork PR must not receive your API key or a
write token. If you need fork support, run the

review in an isolated job with no secrets and post
through a separate trusted workflow.
- The diff a

nd PR metadata are untrusted. The skill forbids following instructions inside them. The
agent still

has tools; do not grant it write permissions beyond what the review needs.
- `gh pr comment` needs `

pull-requests: write`; the default `GITHUB_TOKEN` is read-only in many repos.
- Do not run untrusted

PR code. This action only reads the diff and local checkout by default; the
agent may open files, s
o keep the job read-only.
